title: 1812 Prairie's gable, from the Levy photograph
items: 1812 Prairie's shaped gable now follows the outline in Albert Levy's photograph: its sides curve in to a square stone block at each shoulder, and the head rises as a rounded bell to the finial's plinth instead of a sharp point
The gable's grid window is the photograph's nine small lights, three rows of three between stone mullions and transoms, where three tall lights stood
Each corner of the gable sits on a carved scroll under a small pinnacle, in place of a plain square one
